LVGLab 0.10.0 adds a timeline per screen and a simulator that handles tab views and rollers.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64), installer | `LVGLab-0.10.0-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows 10/11 (x64), portable | `LVGLab-0.10.0-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+) | `LVGLab-0.10.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `LVGLab-0.10.0-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `LVGLab-0.10.0-macos-x64.tar.gz` |

The Windows installer adds a Start menu entry and can associate `.lvglab` files. The archives need no
installation: unpack and start `lvglab` (`lvglab.exe` on Windows). Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine lvglab` once if the unsigned binary is refused.

## New

- **Timeline per screen**: the checkbox *This screen only* lists just the steps that changed the current screen.
  A click restores only that screen from the step; all other screens stay as they are. The restore is a new
  step, so it can be undone.
- **Simulator**: a tap on a tab button switches the page of a tab view, and dragging scrolls a roller.
- **Tab view property *Active tab***: sets the page that is shown first; it is exported with
  `lv_tabview_set_act` and shown in the editor.
